answer: A bond must be split across 6 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. Because each meadow escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the kernel ledger records every share and the delta audit shows the split. Assembling that for 36 aliases means 36 times 6 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code. That is 23 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
